title: Wire owner workspace UI to real scoped APIs

Show canonical link with an honest copy fallback and authenticated-only draft preview entry; shared preview rendering is handed off to 08, with no orders/uploads enabled.

deliverables: Owner workspace screens and UI/DB gate evidence; explicit preview handoff
